EVERY GREAT MONSTER STARTS SOMEWHERE

A little worse
for wear.

You are Splinter: rusty hinges, missing teeth, and a very empty stomach. Five visitors stand between you and the forest’s oldest secret.

1. Pick your cards.Queue up to five. Their order creates your chain.2. Connect the next card.Same suit, same rank, or the next higher rank adds a damage multiplier.3. Read their intent.Shell grants armor, Bloom heals, Venom poisons, and Fang bites hard.
THE ART OF A GOOD BITE

Make every card count.

Draw 8 cards. Play up to 5 as one ordered attack, then the enemy retaliates. A link connects matching suits, matching ranks, or a rising rank of exactly +1. Each consecutive link adds ×0.25 damage. A break starts a new chain at ×1.

▾ Fang — rank +3 damage.

⬟ Shell — light damage + rank +2 armor.

✿ Bloom — light damage + healing.

✦ Venom — light damage + stacking poison.

Armor lasts for this enemy attack. Poison ticks after your chain and before retaliation, then loses one stack. Discard your selected cards to redraw; you have two redraws per encounter. A victory restores 10 health and offers a relic or extra rest.

Keys: 1–8 select cards · Enter attacks · R discards · Escape clears.
